{{Quote|A series of strikes led by Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker eliminated the remaining Separatist bases on the Neimoidian colonial purse worlds of Cato Neimoidia, Deko Neimoidia, and Koru Neimoidia.|A Galactic Alliance historical document|<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
'''Koru Neimoidia''' was a [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was one of the most famous [[Purse world/Legends|purse world]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was a more desirable destination than the Neimoidians' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], itself and hosted opulent residences of affluent and powerful Neimoidians. By [[3643 BBY]], Koru Neimoidia was the site of the headquarters of the [[Opal Foundation]], which was in reality a front for an influential [[Unidentified crime lord (Opal Foundation)|crime lord]]. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] laid [[siege of Koru Neimoidia|siege]] to the planet, which at the time was a possession of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and a stronghold of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Republic forces, [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], eventually devastated and captured the world.

==Description==
Koru Neimoidia, also referred to simply as Koru, was a terrestrial<ref name="Labyrinth" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="DB Cato" /> located in the [[Koru Neimoidia system/Legends|Koru Neimoidia system]] of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It formed a part of [[Neimoidian space]].<ref name="Insider71">{{InsiderCite|71|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:10:05 Edition}}</ref>

==History==
===Opal Foundation===
Koru Neimoidia was among the most famous of [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]], which were in turn the most prestigious of the hundreds of worlds [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="DB Cato" /> of the Colonies planet [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Follow the Money" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an influential [[Unidentified crime lord (Opal Foundation)|crime lord]] who was terrified of war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] established the [[Opal Foundation]] in order to hire [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] for his own protection.<ref name="Follow the Money" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the Sith Empire traveled to the Opal Foundation's headquarters on Koru Neimoidia, where they then discovered the organization's true nature as a front for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] activities.<ref name="Follow the Money" />
{{Endgame}}

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|In response to a decree issued from the Office of the General of the Separatist Army, the Neimoidian Home Defense Legions have doubled conscription service, and called up all reservists for active protection of Neimoidia and the colonial purse-worlds of Deko Neimoidia, Koru Neimoidia and Cato Neimoidia ''[sic]''|Shadowfeed news report|<ref name="Insider71" />}}
By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], both Neimoidia and Koru Neimoidia had become possessions of<ref name="TEA" /> the Neimoidian-controlled<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Eventually, the [[Neimoidian Home Defense Legion/Legends|Neimoidian Home Defense Legions]] doubled conscription service and called up all reservists for protection of both Neimoidia and the purse worlds, including Koru Neimoidia&mdash;a fact that was noted in a [[21 BBY/Legends|14:10:05]] release of the Confederacy's [[Shadowfeed/Legends|Shadowfeed]] news and [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] program.<ref name="Insider71" />

[[File:DynamicDuoROTS-IMDb.png|thumb|right|300px|(From right to left) Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker led a Galactic Republic siege of Koru Neimoidia.]]
Near the end of the Clone Wars, the Republic moved to eliminate the last remaining Confederacy strongholds in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the Colonies,<ref name="TEA" /> carrying out a [[siege of Koru Neimoidia]].<ref name="Labyrinth" /> The offensive was [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="NEC" /> with Kenobi not visiting any of the [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] [[Farm/Legends|farms]] located on the planet during his time there. During the siege, Republic forces including [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] also became familiar with the layout of the local Neimoidian [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]. Koru Neimoidia was eventually devastated<ref name="Labyrinth" /> and captured by the Republic.<ref name="OSVC33" />

In 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the Republic attempted to [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|capture]] the Trade Federation [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], who had traveled to the purse world [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] in order to loot his [[Nute Gunray's citadel|citadel]] there. At the time, Kenobi mused that, given the fate of both Koru Neimoidia and its fellow captured purse world [[Deko Neimoidia/Legends|Deko Neimoidia]] as well as the Republic threatening Neimoidia itself, it would have been more rational for Gunray to instead retreat to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] similarly to the actions of other Confederacy leaders. During a tactical discussion held between Kenobi, Skywalker, and Cody as part of the operation, Cody recalled the Republic's experiences on Koru Neimoidia when speculating about the layout of Gunray's citadel.<ref name="Labyrinth" /> The Republic offensive on Koru Neimoidia was later also noted in the [[36 ABY]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|chronicle]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Inhabitants==
Although, like all of the Neimoidian purse worlds, Koru Neimoidia was politically subservient to the [[Trade monarch/Legends|trade monarch]] based on Neimoidia, the former world's influence on interstellar commerce eventually eclipsed that of the latter.<ref name="TEA" /> Koru Neimoidia itself was also developed to the point where it became a more hospitable and desirable destination than Neimoidia.<ref name="DesperateAllies">''[[Desperate Allies]]''</ref>

==Locations==
{{Quote|Assuming that Gunray's fortress is similar to what we found on Deko and Koru, the underground levels will contain fungus farms and processing and shipment areas.|Cody|<ref name="Labyrinth" />}}
Koru Neimoidia was home to large, lavish settlements and palace-like residences of affluent and powerful Neimoidians.<ref name="OSVC33" /> At one point, it also hosted the headquarters of the Opal Foundation.<ref name="Follow the Money" /> Similarly to Deko Neimoidia, by the time of the Clone Wars Koru Neimoidia was the site of a fortress that featured underground [[fungus farm]]s and processing and shipment areas as well as Neimoidian [[Grub-hatchery|grub hatcheries]] on its mid levels.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

==Behind the scenes==
Koru Neimoidia was first mentioned in "[[CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:10:05 Edition]]," an article written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] as an [[CIS Shadowfeed (Insider)|in-universe news report]]. It was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 71|seventy-first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider71" /> on [[September 26]], [[2003]].<ref name="Insider71 date">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/09/news20030924.html|text=Collectors Extravaganza in ''Insider'' #71}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Koru Neimoidia in grid square N-11.<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was mentioned in an Investigation Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Follow the Money" />
